name: – Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan – After recital A – Am 9
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: Aa. whereas the RRF was conceived with a lack of due preparation, putting the EU’s budget at significant risk until 2058; calls on the Commission to take into account the observations made by the ECA and to verify monitoring mechanisms in order to effectively assess the actual efficiency of the investments made;
